foodZone.title: Food & Bars
foodZone.body:
Food Zones

At Tbilisi Style 21, you will discover food spaces inspired by traditional Georgian architecture, including wooden cottages and areas designed in the style of old Georgian houses, giving the festival a unique visual identity.

The Food Zones will feature cuisine from different countries. Dishes will be prepared by chefs from Italy, Ukraine, and Georgia, offering guests a diverse and modern gastronomic experience.

Due to the scale of the festival, chefs and their teams will work as quickly and efficiently as possible to ensure fast service and minimize waiting times.

The food areas will be divided into one central zone and two additional smaller zones, making movement and access to services easier and more comfortable for guests.

Vegetarian and vegan options will also be available.

Additionally, the Food Zones will include:

* Comfortable seating and relaxation areas
* Open kitchen concept (live cooking)
* A late-night food zone operating until the end of the festival
* A fast and optimized menu adapted to the festival's rhythm
* A modern service system designed to reduce waiting times

All payments at the festival will be cashless only, using bank cards, ensuring fast, secure, and smooth service.

Food Zones will be more than just dining areas - they will become a social and visual experience where taste, culture, and festival energy come together.

Bars

The festival will feature a bar system designed to be maximum comfortable and easily accessible for guests.

The main bar will be located in the central area, while additional bars will be placed near the Food Zones and across different festival locations, allowing guests to receive fast service from any point of the venue.

This system will help reduce queues, provide fast service, and maintain the continuous energy and flow of the festival.

fourStages.title: 4 Stages - Tbilisi Style 21 x Qvevri Festival
fourStages.body:
At the joint festival of Tbilisi Style 21 and Qvevri, 4 unique stages will be presented, which create a complete musical experience - with different energy, style, and atmosphere.
Two main spaces are already known: Qvevri Stage and Main Stage, which represent the heart of the festival. Together with them, the festival also brings together two special additional stages:
Live Corner - Live Performance Space
Live Corner is a place where music comes alive.
Here will appear artists who create their music on the spot and in real time transmit emotion, energy, and character.
This space is not just a stage - it is an experience for those who not only play music, but live within it.
Guests will remember the artists presented at Live Corner for their professionalism, hard work, and deep love for music.
Every day, 3 DJs will perform on the stage.
Future Generation Stage - The Stage of the New Generation
The fourth stage is entirely dedicated to the new generation - young DJs and emerging artists from all over the world.
Here you will meet new talents who are still at the beginning of their careers, but already carry the energy that leads them to the big stage.
This is a space for those who are still unknown to a wide audience, but are already ready to establish their place on the electronic scene with their talent and hard work.
Tbilisi Style 21 gives young artists the opportunity to perform at a big festival for the first time, grow, and take their first steps on a big musical journey.
On the Future Generation Stage, we will have 5 DJs every day.
These four stages together create one complete world - where experience, live music, and the energy of the new generation unite into a single festival.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.body:
Hello, my name is Beka Abzianidze, born in Tbilisi. I first entered a club at the age of 17, and from that moment I became deeply interested in this world. Long story short, from 2019 until New Year 2026, I lived in Kyiv. It was exactly there that I realized it was finally time to share my festival idea with the world.
At first, I explored the scene in Kyiv itself - watching what was happening, how events were organized, and what kind of energy they created. Later, I went beyond its borders and attended several major festivals, where I experienced the atmosphere that only large-scale festivals can create.
If you had opened my Instagram page during that time, you would have seen that I followed every great event happening around me. Of course, I was also paying close attention to the events in Tbilisi and knew exactly what was happening there. Tbilisi is a stylish city - no matter what you create, it somehow fits naturally into its spirit.
During that period in Kyiv, I had my own small movement going on. One day, a Ukrainian man gifted me a handmade bunch of grapes made from iron. At the same time, I was living in Vinogradar, having arrived from the country of grapes itself - Georgia. That moment inspired the idea of creating the festival "Tbilisi Style 21," where grapes would become one of its symbolic elements.
From there, I began building the vision of a festival that would unite Georgian culture with modern electronic music. I always believed that bringing people together was one of my strengths, and that belief had a huge influence on my decision. That is why I decided to stand at the head of such a large and ambitious project.
Of course, none of this can become reality without your support.
Tbilisi Style 21

rulesAndTerms.title: Rules & Terms
rulesAndTerms.body:
Rules & Terms
QR Code and Entry
After purchasing a ticket, the user will receive a unique QR code at the email address provided during registration. Upon entry to the festival area, the user is required to present the QR code and an identity document (passport), based on the presentation and verification of which an entry wristband will be issued. The QR code is for single use only and is subject to verification. After the QR code is exchanged, the ticket is considered used and cannot be reused or exchanged. The festival organizer reserves the right to refuse issuing an entry wristband if the QR code is damaged, altered, already used, or fails verification.

Ticket Refund
The user has the right to request a ticket refund only if they notify the festival representative in writing no later than 15 working days before the festival date. In case of a ticket refund, the user will receive 50% of the paid amount. If the user does not notify the organizer within the specified period or applies later, the paid amount is non-refundable. The refund will be processed no later than 15 working days after the festival, using the same payment method that was used to purchase the ticket.

Festival Cancellation or Postponement
In the event of festival cancellation, the user will receive a full refund of the ticket price. In case of festival postponement, the ticket remains valid for the new date. If the user does not agree with the new date and requests a refund, the paid amount will be refunded minus the service fee and applicable VAT. The refund will be processed within the timeframe determined by the organizer, using the same payment method used for ticket purchase.

Lost Ticket
In case of loss, deletion, or transfer of the ticket (QR code) to a third party, the organizer is not obliged to restore the ticket or issue a refund. The user is responsible for the safe storage of the ticket (QR code) before and during the festival. The organizer is not responsible for cases where the ticket is used by a third party due to the user's negligence.

Lost Wristband
In case of loss, damage, or removal of the entry wristband received at the festival, the user is prohibited from re-entering the festival area. Lost, damaged, or removed wristbands are not subject to replacement or restoration. The organizer is not obliged to issue a new wristband or provide a refund in such cases. The user is required to keep the wristband intact throughout the festival.

Technical Issues
In the event of technical issues, the organizer is obliged to take reasonable measures to resolve the problem as quickly as possible, including issues related to QR code scanning, electronic systems, or internet connectivity. Technical disruptions do not automatically constitute grounds for ticket cancellation or refund, except in cases where the technical issue completely prevents the user from attending the festival due to the organizer's fault. The organizer is not responsible for disruptions caused by third-party systems, including payment platforms, telecom operators, or internet providers.

Updates
All important updates, changes, and announcements related to the festival (including program, artists, schedule, rules, and other information) will be published on the official festival website and/or official social media channels. The user is obliged to regularly review the information published through these sources. The organizer reserves the right to make reasonable changes to the festival program and rules without prior notice in case of unforeseen circumstances.

Contact and Support
For any questions, issues, or additional information, the user may contact the organizer via email at tbilisistyle@gmail.com or through the festival's official social media channels. The organizer will make reasonable efforts to respond to inquiries within a reasonable timeframe; however, response times may depend on the nature and volume of requests.

List of Prohibited Items
* Sharp objects and cold weapons
* Narcotic substances
* Pyrotechnics and fireworks
* Glass bottles and containers
* Use of drones on the festival territory

Security Personnel Rights
Security personnel have the right to:
* Conduct inspections
* Refuse entry to users
* Remove guests from the territory in case of rule violations

Weather Conditions (Open-Air Event)
The festival will be held in all weather conditions. Weather conditions do not constitute grounds for a refund.

Photo and Video Recording
Photo and video recording will take place on the festival territory. The guest agrees that their image may be used in various promotional materials.

Lost and Found Items
The organizer is not responsible for items lost or stolen on the festival territory. A designated lost and found area will be available at the festival, where found items will be handed over to the organizer's representatives. The owner may retrieve their item from this area upon presentation of appropriate identification.

mainStage.title: Main Stage
mainStage.p1: At Tbilisi Style we will have a large main stage measuring 60 × 15 meters. A stage where every detail matters. Here you will find a unique decoration  human hands transformed into a DJ booth, where top European DJs will deliver their maximum performance.
mainStage.p2: On the main stage there will be a wall covered with vines and grape clusters, enhanced by large-scale LED screens and professional European-style technical equipment. This is a place where energy, visuals, and music merge into one big show. Georgian culture and European modernity come together in one space  this is Tbilisi Style.
mainStage.p4: The stage will feature moving screens that will change their form and visual concept every day, making each day a unique show.
mainStage.p3: Every day, 6 DJs will perform on the main stage, creating a full-night musical journey.
mainStage.p5: Music on the stage will not be limited to one genre different electronic directions will merge into one energy and turn every night into a new experience.

qvevriStage.title: Qvevri Stage
qvevriStage.p1: At the Tbilisi Style 21 festival, you will encounter a massive Qvevri-shaped structure. Since ancient times, Georgians have used qvevris for winemaking, a tradition that spans centuries and represents one of the most important parts of Georgian culture. The unique method of fermenting wine in qvevris has introduced Georgia to the world as one of the oldest and most distinguished homelands of winemaking art.
qvevriStage.p2: Now, you will have the opportunity to fully "squeeze yourselves like grapes" inside the giant qvevri, where techno-loving DJs will perform. Unlike the main stage, they will deliver a heavier, darker, and more industrial sound direction including hard techno, industrial techno, peak-time techno, and underground rave sounds, providing guests with maximum energy and intensity throughout the festival.
qvevriStage.p3: Inside the qvevri, the ceiling will feature the unique three Georgian alphabets. In the center of the stage, there will be a massive inverted triangular LED screen, creating a strong visual focal point for the entire space. Additionally, there will be two balconies for Joker and VIP zones. The total capacity of the qvevri will be 7,000 people.

technoQvevri.title: TECHNO RAVE - QVEVRI
technoQvevri.p1: We begin a new night inside the Qvevri.
technoQvevri.p4: This is unstoppable, heavy TECHNO RAVE.
technoQvevri.p5: After Tbilisi Style 21 and the Qvevri Festival, on September 11, 2027, we invite you into the Great Qvevri, where the music will not stop.
technoQvevri.p6: Leading European DJs will try to saturate the thick walls of the Qvevri with the energy of heavy and relentless techno.
technoQvevri.p7: This will be the first night when the Great Qvevri in Georgia turns completely red, and the people inside will feel like pressed grapes.
technoQvevri.p8: If you have never experienced true exhaustion while dancing - this is your night.
technoQvevri.p9: A unique night with European techno artists.
technoQvevri.p10: We welcome only those who are ready for pure energy on the dancefloor.
technoQvevri.ticketNote: To purchase tickets, visit the tickets section.

mission.title: Goal
mission.subtitle: Tbilisi Style 21
mission.p1: To organize the Tbilisi Style festival, we need the support of at least 30,000 people it does not matter whether they are Georgians or representatives from any other country. With this level of support, we will be able to organize Tbilisi Style in 2027, build a huge qvevri in Tbilisi, and create an atmosphere and environment where every person will feel fully charged with energy.
mission.p2: Our goal is to unite Georgian culture with modern electronic music trends, and to give talented people the opportunity to learn, experience, and see a European-level festival with their own eyes, hear live performances from world-class DJs, and gain experience that will strongly contribute to their personal and professional development.
mission.p3: Georgia has great potential in music and dance. However, today we do not have DJs of such scale, nor a festival that can travel to different countries and deliver events at the same level as leading European festivals currently do.
mission.p4: In reality, there is no problem with musical talent or creativity in Georgia. What is needed is unity. Tbilisi Style and creative music lovers will have the opportunity to bring this together and show the world what people can achieve when they unite.
mission.p5: We believe that the Tbilisi Style festival, with the support of people, has the potential to become a world-class festival that can take place in different countries and significantly increase the tourism appeal of any region, just like Tomorrowland, Ultra, Zamna, and other leading festivals do today.
mission.p6: Georgians have the opportunity to establish themselves in this field and have representatives on the global stage.
mission.p7: If there is a desire to have a European-level Tbilisi Style festival in Tbilisi, we will definitely need your support. Support can be expressed in different ways: purchasing tickets, sharing information with others, involving European friends, or any other form of contribution. The Tbilisi Style team needs creative thinkers who are not focused only on financial benefit, but who also care about promoting Georgia’s name internationally and pushing it forward on the global stage.

ukrainianDay.title: Ukrainian Day
ukrainianDay.p1: The second day of the Tbilisi Style 21 festival will be dedicated to Ukrainian Day. On this day, the Main Stage, Qvevri, and other central areas will be fully powered by the energy of Ukrainian DJs, creating a unique atmosphere.
ukrainianDay.p2: Ukrainian representatives will open and close the festival, sharing their energy and showcasing their talent on a global stage.
ukrainianDay.p3: If you have never experienced Ukrainian artists on a big stage, this is your opportunity to become part of it.
ukrainianDay.highlight: Don't miss the Ukrainian vibe in Tbilisi.
ukrainianDay.p4: The organization of Ukrainian Day is led by Aisha from Kyiv, a talented and dedicated young professional who is shaping the future of this project.
ukrainianDay.closing: 28.08.2027 - See you in Tbilisi for Ukrainian Day.

jokerTicket.body:
The Joker Ticket is a special category ticket for the Tbilisi Style 21 electronic music festival. The ticket gives its holder access to the Joker Zone.
A person who purchases a Joker Ticket becomes an official "Joker User" of Tbilisi Style 21 and receives a special status.
Tbilisi Style 21 will have its own selected "Joker DJ" artist, who will be chosen according to the audience's wishes and engagement. Users can message us or tag us on social media and name their favorite DJ. The organization will definitely contact the selected artist and will try, based on the people's request, to officially name them the DJ Joker of Tbilisi Style 21. The artist will also receive a memorable gift from the festival and the Joker symbol.
Just as Gotham had its own Joker in the world of Gotham City, Tbilisi Style 21 will also have its own chosen Joker, who at the very first festival will be supported by 5,000 "Joker People." This number will grow every year, with 200-300 new Joker People added each season.
The Joker Ticket will be available under a promotional offer until November 30, 2026.
"Joker People" will hold a status higher than VIP ticket holders, because they will receive: Discounts on all future Tbilisi Style 21 events
Special Joker privileges and permanent access to the advantages of the Joker system
The Joker Card does not lose its validity at any future Tbilisi Style 21 festival. The more the number of Joker People grows, the more surprises and exclusive experiences will be added to the Tbilisi Style 21 community.
